introduction:
A Death Certificate in Telangana is issued by the GHMC, Municipality, or Gram Panchayat under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act. Telangana uses the CDMA (Commissioner and Director of Municipal Administration) portal and Dharani for property-related death registrations.

Essential for insurance claims, property mutation, bank settlement, pension, and succession proceedings. Applications via MeeSeva centers or the CRS portal.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • State: Telangana
  • Platform Used: MeeSeva 2.0 Portal (ts.meeseva.telangana.gov.in)
  • Service Name: Birth and Death Certificate CDMA
  • Application Fee: ₹85 (paid online)
  • Document Upload Limit: PDF format only, file size must be under 3 MB
  • Processing Time: Generally takes about 1 week
  • Pre-requisite: The death must have already been recorded by the hospital or local municipality/panchayat so that the record exists in the online database.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Requirement: Ensure all uploaded documents are in PDF format and under 3 MB in size.
Application Form
  • CDMA Application for Death Certificate: A specific form that must be downloaded from the MeeSeva portal, manually filled out, and scanned as a PDF.
Identity Proofs
  • Applicant's Aadhaar Card
  • Deceased Person's Aadhaar Card
  • Ration Card (Optional)
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application via MeeSeva 2.0 Portal

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit Portal & Login: Open your browser and go to the MeeSeva 2.0 portal (ts.meeseva.telangana.gov.in). Log in using your Citizen Login ID and password. (If you don't have an account, click on "New User" to create one in a few minutes).
  2. Select CDMA Service: Once logged in, use the search bar on the main dashboard to type "Death". From the options that appear, select "Birth and Death Certificate CDMA". In the "Service Type" dropdown, select "Death Certificate".
  3. Find the Record:
    • If you already know the Registration Unit ID, enter it.
    • If you don't know it, click on the "Search" option. A pop-up window will open. Select the District, Location Name (Municipal Corporation/Municipality/Gram Panchayat), and Registration Unit ID from the drop-downs. Select the Death Year, Gender (Male/Female), enter the exact Date of Death, and click "Get Details".
  4. Verify and Submit Record: A list of matching records will appear. Verify the deceased person's name and home address, check the box next to the correct record, and click Submit.
  5. Confirm Details: The Registration Number and Year will auto-fill on the main screen. Click "Get Details" again. The deceased's details will populate.
  6. Fill Informant Details: Scroll down to the "Informant Details" section and fill in:
    • Applicant Name and Informant Relationship (e.g., Son, Wife).
    • Applicant's full address and Mobile Number.
    • Applicant's Aadhaar Number (Ration Card Number and Email ID are optional).
  7. Select Delivery & Purpose: Select "Postal" if you want it delivered to your home, or "Manual" if you want to print it yourself later at a physical MeeSeva center. Enter the Purpose of Certificate (e.g., "General").
  8. Upload CDMA Form: Go to the MeeSeva home page, click on "Application Forms" under the "Downloads" tab, and download the "CDMA Application for Death Certificate". Fill it out with a pen, scan it as a PDF (under 3MB), and upload it in the "Uploaded Documents" section on the application page.
  9. Payment: Click "Show Payment". The fee of ₹85 will be displayed. Click "Confirm Payment", choose your payment method (HDFC/Paytm/BillDesk gateways for Card/UPI/Net Banking), and complete the transaction. Download and save the generated receipt.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Offline Application (For Unregistered Deaths or Walk-ins)

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit Local Authorities/MeeSeva: Go to the local administrative office where the death occurred (Gram Panchayat office in rural areas, or Municipal Corporation/Municipality office in urban areas) or visit a nearby physical MeeSeva Center.
  2. Get the Form: Request a physical Death Registration Application Form.
  3. Fill and Attach: Fill out the form with details like the deceased's name, date, and place of death. Attach supporting documents, including the hospital death slip (Medical Certificate of Cause of Death), the deceased's Aadhaar card, and the applicant's ID proof.
  4. Submit and Pay: Submit the form and documents to the staff. Pay the required application fee at the counter and collect your acknowledgment receipt.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Delivery & Collection Details

Postal Delivery

If you selected "Postal" delivery during the online application, the physical certificate will be mailed to the applicant's address once approved.

Manual Printing/Collection

If you selected "Manual" delivery online, you will receive an "Approved" SMS on your mobile (usually within 1 week). Take your payment receipt, printed application, and copies of the applicant and deceased Aadhaar cards to any physical MeeSeva center to get the certificate printed.

Offline Applications Collection

If you applied entirely offline at a MeeSeva center, you can return to that center with your acknowledgment receipt to collect the printed certificate once it is ready.
